step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify visual nodes from the whiteboard:
   - CloudFormation (top center)
   - ServerlessApplicationRepository labeled 'AWS SAR' (top right)
   - Greengrass (bottom)
   - UserConsumerMobile labeled 'WEB/MOBILE CLIENT' (left)
   - Customer Account container containing:
     - Cognito
     - ApiGateway ('API GW')
     - Lambda
     - IoTCore ('IOT CORE')
     - DynamoDB

2. Trace connections (Visual-first):
   - CloudFormation points to the Customer Account boundary to deploy infrastructure services.
   - Greengrass connects to IoT Core.
   - IoT Core connects to DynamoDB.
   - Web/Mobile Client connects to Cognito for authentication.
   - Web/Mobile Client connects to API Gateway for API requests.
   - Web/Mobile Client connects to IoT Core directly for real-time MQTT data and shadows.
